selection_basis: No canonical continuity_mining queue item existed; selected the highest-priority semantic integrity gap exposed by CM-012 without modifying V-001 or another team's state.
memory_recovered: Observed, inferred, proposed, superseded, and unresolved are not stylistic headings; they are distinct epistemic states with different evidence thresholds and transition rules.
completed_slice: Added a machine-readable continuity claim-state lexicon.
Defined minimum evidence and prohibited shortcuts for all five states.
Defined permitted and forbidden transitions while preserving append-only history.
Recorded non-equivalence rules separating repository, runtime, deployment, real-world truth, and peer-trigger evidence.
Bound the lexicon to a privacy rule that permits provenance metadata while excluding raw private narratives.

claim_states.observed: The canonical queue contains only V-001; CM-012 uses five claim-state labels; the new lexicon exists at commit 9d191854a8dcc4c686093be40730966f27cfc86a and was fetched successfully from the default branch.
claim_states.inferred: Centralized state semantics reduce cross-team evidence drift and silent promotion of inference into observation.
claim_states.proposed: Cross-check the existing claim-transition validator against this lexicon and add dependency-free linting in a later slice.
claim_states.superseded: The implicit assumption that the five state labels have sufficiently uniform meaning without a canonical artifact.
claim_states.unresolved: The lexicon is not yet enforced by the validator; exact-commit continuity workflow artifacts and independent JSON Schema 2020-12 comparison remain unobserved.

verification: The committed lexicon was fetched from GitHub after creation; its five states, transition sets, evidence layers, non-equivalence rules, privacy boundary, and compatibility clauses were directly inspected.
privacy_boundary: Repository metadata and abstract claim-state semantics only; no raw private chat excerpts or private health, identity, relationship, or location narratives were committed.
next_action: Add a dependency-free validator that rejects transition records whose state semantics or transitions conflict with operations/continuity/CLAIM_STATE_LEXICON.json, then bind that check to the exact-commit continuity workflow.
